name: Storm Puddle
primary:
An electrified puddle for area control.
A zone at the aim point with a 2.5-block radius for 15 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 1 ❤ lightning + 1 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 8.8 s
• Light push
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 8.8 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
